title: Claude Code auto mode: where it takes effect
question: Which way of asking for auto mode actually starts a Claude Code session in auto, per version, and what the session shows when it doesn't?
method: Fresh empty git repo per case on Linux; headless: claude -p with stream-json, permissionMode read from the system/init event; interactive: pty-driven session, status line and Shift+Tab cycle read from the rendered screen. User-level defaultMode is bypassPermissions unless the case says otherwise. One run per case.
